notes: Builds 167 through 171 bumped this file's numbers but never rebuilt the APK itself, which bundles the app as a baked-in asset rather than loading it live — so Check for updates correctly offered a download each time, but installing it left the app on whatever build last actually went through android/build.sh. This build is the real one: it carries everything since, including Profiles, the edit-model install fixes, and the reference-edit instruction rewrite. Also fixed the Profiles row's icon, which silently fell back to raw text ("switch_account") because the app's offline icon font is a hand-picked subset that didn't include it yet.
